The main takeaway from our work is that
the throughput of a sender in multi-hop wireless network is determined by a number of factors that are not present in WLANs.
the transmit power should be adjusted to maximize the number of neighbors, while the carrier sense threshold should be adjusted to minimize the number of neighbors.
the network capacity is not a function of only the number of nodes, but also a function of the PHY/MAC attributes.
